preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hiv_observation WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND (data -> 'tbIptScreening' ->> 'status') = 'Confirmed TB' AND (data -> 'tbIptScreening' ->> 'outcome') = 'Not Presumptive' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.comment: Update tbIptScreening status from 'Confirmed TB' to 'No Signs or symptoms of TB' where outcome is 'Not Presumptive'
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hiv_observation SET data = jsonb_set( data, '{tbIptScreening,status}', '"No signs or symptoms of TB"' ) WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND (data -> 'tbIptScreening' ->> 'status') = 'Confirmed TB' AND (data -> 'tbIptScreening' ->> 'outcome') = 'Not Presumptive';
